note: Rustic state forest campground on Garnet Lake (northern pike, perch), about a mile from Garnet in Mackinac County, eastern UP; run by Hudson Township. Larger rigs may find sites tight. The Newberry-Rexton Trail (66 miles of motorcycle trail, 5 miles of ORV route) is a mile southeast; steelhead in the Black River five miles southwest. --Claude
summary: DNR page: 10 sites, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed; the 15-night max had been inherited). Managed by Hudson Township (DNR page), and it is not in the DNR's state forest amenity table, so its fee and season are unconfirmed: the inherited $20 was left inherited (the page's '$20 for most sites' is the statewide boilerplate). Phone and ownership flagged. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Phone: the entry has none; the DNR page lists 906-420-3508 and says 'Garnet Lake State Forest Campground is under the management of Hudson Township. Any concerns or questions about this campground should be directed to the Township at the phone number identified above.'

Ownership/agency: run by Hudson Township (Mackinac County) on state forest land; the DNR page says so and the campground is absent from the DNR state forest campground amenity table (no managing park, fee or closure dates listed). Stored 'state' with policy_ref state:michigan-state-forests; a human should decide whether it should be 'local' (as Ely Lake was). A web search turned up a third-party claim of $10/night, unconfirmed on any township page; the inherited $20 was left inherited rather than confirmed.
